pages.title: Richard Ojeda for NC09 - United We Win
pages.text:
## We Win
Major Ret. Richard Ojeda is running for US Congress in North Carolina’s 9th District to fight for American Families, Veterans, and the future of our democracy.
## Join Team Ojeda
The appearance of U.S. Department of Defense visual information does not imply or constitute DOD endorsement.
Note: If you have donated through ActBlue, these links will take you through express checkout.
## Why support our campaign?
Voting isn’t just about picking a name. It’s about choosing someone who will fight for you, listen to your story, and stand up for what matters in North Carolina. Here’s why Richard Ojeda is the clear choice for NC-09 and the people who call it home.
We represent the people, not the powerful.
This campaign doesn’t take a dime from corporate PACs or lobbyists. Our strength comes from small-dollar donations and grassroots support, proving that when everyday people chip in, we can take on Washington.
We listen before we speak.
This campaign is built on conversations, not backroom deals. Richard listens to veterans, teachers, farmers, and families, shaping his platform from the real stories and struggles of North Carolinians.
We show up in every corner of NC-09.
Richard isn’t hiding in offices or talking to insiders. He’s on the road, putting boots on the ground, at fish fries, car shows, union halls, and community meetings, listening to concerns and standing shoulder to shoulder with neighbors.
We fight for those left behind.
Too many families feel ignored by politicians. Richard is committed to lifting up the voices of rural towns, veterans in need, overworked teachers, and workers pushed aside by corporate greed.
We believe change starts in our community.
Real change doesn’t come from Washington. It comes from neighbors talking to neighbors, volunteers knocking doors, and communities standing together. That’s the movement Richard is building across NC-09.
## Meet Ret. Major Richard Ojeda
This campaign is about service. Richard Ojeda has spent his career in the military, as a teacher, and as a fighter in state legislature. When he goes to D.C., you can count on his commitment to:
## Representing Real People
Richard Hudson has been putting the interests of billionaires before those of working families in N.C. That stops now.
## Country Over Party
This country is at a turning point, and we deserve leaders who know what it means to serve and stand for our nation, united.
## Fight for Veterans
Protect and improve VA care, pensions, and mental health support for veterans.
## Protect Education
Raise teacher pay, cut student debt, and keep politics out of the classroom.
## Invest in North Carolina
## Ensure Quality Healthcare
## Stand by Working Families
## Save the Future of Social Security
Raise the income cap and stop retirement age hikes.
## Let’s take Congress back.
There are so many ways you can help us flip this seat and start righting the ship. With our democracy at stake, there’s no time like today to get involved.

pages.title: Fighting for Veterans - Richard Ojeda for NC09
pages.text:
## Veterans deserve care, respect, and real action.
Richard Hudson calls himself the “veterans’ representative” but he votes to tear down veterans at every turn. I served for 24 years, and as a retired Army Major, I know firsthand what it means to serve. Veterans deserve more than words. They deserve healthcare, pensions, and respect that matches the sacrifice they gave this nation.
Stop the assault on the VA workforce from politicians like Richard Hudson
Protect pensions and benefits veterans have already earned.
Prioritize mental health care for veterans and families.
## Healthcare Access
Every veteran deserves timely, quality VA healthcare without months of waiting.
## Fair
No one who served should ever have to fear losing retirement or disability benefits.
## Mental
Expand access to counseling and treatment to end veteran suicide.
## Community Support
Stronger outreach programs to connect veterans with local resources and jobs.
## No veteran should be left behind to fund tax breaks for billionaires
Congressmen like Richard Hudson make promises to veterans and then forget them. I will never forget my fellow service members. Here are answers to the most important questions veterans and their families are asking.
How will you fix VA care?
I will fight to expand facilities in North Carolina, hire more staff, and cut red tape so veterans are not left waiting months for appointments or denied the care they earned.
What about pensions and retirement security?
I will oppose any attempt to cut military pensions or disability benefits. These are promises made to service members. Breaking them dishonors service and hurts families who sacrificed for this country.
Will you focus on mental health?
Yes. We must expand VA mental health services, increase access to counseling, and address PTSD and suicide directly. Veterans deserve care that matches the invisible battles they still face.
How will families be supported?
Military families serve too. I will strengthen spousal support programs, improve education opportunities, and expand job training so families have stability and opportunity after years of sacrifice.
Why trust you to deliver?
Because the VA is my care in the community. I know the challenges of military service, the frustration of fighting bureaucracy, and the need for quality healthcare for those who have earned it. Service is about standing up for one another and we must stand ready to care for those we have sent into harms way.

## Fight for Veterans
Better VA care, fair pensions, and mental health support for veterans.
## Protect Education

## Invest in NC
## Ensure Quality Healthcare
## Stand by Working Families

Protect Social Security, stop retirement age hikes, and block new penalties.
